'''Comar''' was a [[lord]] in [[Andor]], and secretly a [[Darkfriend]]. 

== Appearance ==
He was tall with wide shoulders, blue eyes, and a close cut black beard with a white streak over his chin. 

== Activities ==
He was sent by [[Lord Gaebril]] to hunt down and kill [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]]. He was overheard receiving this assignment by [[Matrim Cauthon]],{{ref/book|3|46}} who followed him to [[Tear]] and found him at [[The Golden Cup]] inn.{{ref/book|3|49}} Comar was gambling using two sets of dice to win from the locals. Mat gambles with him and wins even though they used the same loaded dice. Mat then confronts Comar and, after a brief scuffle, throws him on to a table, unintentionally breaking his back.
